social_circle.name: Emily Mullins

demographics.occupation: full-time administrative coordinator for a school or community nonprofit

background.how_they_met: She met Jeffrey through mutual friends at a trivia night in St. Charles, where they started talking afterward about books and local hiking spots.
background.why_close: They are married, live together, share household responsibilities, and she is his main emotional support person. She also pushes him to think beyond routines and read more about social issues.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Warm and observant, usually texts in complete sentences with quick practical check-ins. She uses light humor, occasional emojis, and notices when Jeffrey sounds stressed.

shared_activities: driving into St. Louis for museums or concerts
recent_text_topics: Coordinating dinner, errands, and whether Jeffrey's route is running late.
Checking in about his knee soreness, sleep, and stress during heavy parcel days.
Planning a weekend hike, museum outing, or quiet night with a game on.
Talking through household costs, groceries, and delayed home projects.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q01 says Jeffrey met Emily through mutual friends at trivia night in St. Charles. Q05 says, 'I am married to Emily' and 'She is my main person.' Q11, Q51, and Q55 show they live together and share cooking, cleaning, bills, and expenses. Q43 says Emily can usually tell when he is carrying stress before he says it.

social_circle.name: Mark Mullins

background.how_they_met: Mark is Jeffrey's younger brother; they grew up together in the Defiance and St. Charles County area.
background.why_close: They are not daily-phone-call close, but they have a steady sibling bond built around family obligations, sports, tools, and helping their parents.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Short, casual texts with practical details, sports comments, and the occasional joke. He is more likely to send a quick photo or one-line update than a long message.

shared_activities: talking about tools and car issues
recent_text_topics: Planning who can help their parents with errands, appointments, yard work, or weather-related needs.
Texting during Cardinals games and reacting to close innings.
Comparing notes about tools, car maintenance, and brake or oil-change questions.
Coordinating holiday meals and family birthday plans.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q06 says Jeffrey has 'one younger brother, Mark' and that they 'text about sports, tools, and family plans.' Q35 says Mark also helps with their aging parents, though schedules can make it uneven. Q99 confirms Mark lived with Jeffrey during childhood.

social_circle.name: Aaron Becker

background.how_they_met: Aaron and Jeffrey met through work at USPS in St. Charles County.
background.why_close: Their friendship extends beyond work because they hike together, understand the physical strain of mail delivery, and can talk practically when work stress gets heavy.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Direct and informal. He texts in fragments, sends weather screenshots, complains lightly about route chaos, and uses humor more than emotional language.

recent_text_topics: Planning a hike when the weather and Jeffrey's knees cooperate.
Checking in after heavy package days and joking about route adjustments.
Talking privately about stress during winter rush or staffing problems.
Sharing practical advice about shoes, stretching, loading order, and pacing.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q07 identifies Aaron as 'a coworker I hike with sometimes.' Q49 says that after Emily, Jeffrey would message 'Aaron or my brother' for support. Q44 says he told 'a coworker I trust' during a rough work period, and Q77 identifies Aaron as his closest coworker.

social_circle.name: Linda Mullins

demographics.education: some college and office administration training

background.how_they_met: Linda is Jeffrey's mother and raised him in a stable two-parent household in Defiance.
background.why_close: Jeffrey sees his parents regularly, helps them with errands and appointments, and credits his mother with teaching patience, organization, and the importance of invisible work.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts politely and clearly, often with reminders, appointment details, and family updates. She may use punctuation carefully and send follow-up clarifications.

recent_text_topics: Scheduling medical appointments and asking whether Jeffrey or Mark can drive.
Planning Sunday lunch and checking what Emily and Jeffrey can bring.
Updating Jeffrey about her mobility trouble or his father's blood pressure.
Asking for help understanding paperwork, bills, or a computer issue.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Her first name is inferred because Jeffrey's mother is not named. Q05 says Jeffrey sees his parents every couple of weeks, usually for Sunday lunch or to help around their house. Q35 says his mom has had mobility trouble and he helps with errands and appointments. Q103 says his mother worked as a school office administrator and taught him patience and organization.

social_circle.name: Tricia Wallace

background.how_they_met: Tricia and her husband Mike became friends with Jeffrey and Emily through their shared social circle and recurring board-game nights.
background.why_close: She is part of Jeffrey's small trusted social circle. Their friendship is low-drama and routine-based, centered on board games, food, local events, and relaxed couple friendships.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Upbeat and plan-oriented. She texts in complete sentences, uses occasional exclamation points, and often coordinates dates, snacks, and which game to bring.

shared_activities: board-game nights with Mike and Emily
playing Ticket to Ride, Wingspan, Catan, and cooperative games
casual meals or snacks during game nights
recent_text_topics: Scheduling the next board-game night around Jeffrey's USPS overtime and Emily's work schedule.
Debating whether to play Wingspan, Catan, Ticket to Ride, or a cooperative game.
Coordinating snacks, dinner, and whether to keep the night low-key.
Sharing local arts or community workshop ideas that overlap with Jeffrey's interest in free arts programming.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q07 explicitly names 'Mike and Tricia' as friends Jeffrey and Emily play board games with once or twice a month. Q07 follow-up lists Ticket to Ride, Wingspan, Catan, and cooperative games. Q49 says Jeffrey relies on Emily and close friends for emotional support, supporting inclusion of close non-family friends.
